verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app-building platform, so a public interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents MCP tools such as get_logs and query_database, but never mentions an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404. MCP tool descriptions are an adjacent feature and do not count as an explorable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
